lines.zh: 我走过焦土，脚印冒着烟。
lines.en: I cross scorched earth, my prints still smoking.

lines.zh: 身形和玩家一样高，可更沉。
lines.en: Player-height, but much heavier.
Every step packs the ash down.
Armor rings at my shoulder.
I drift toward your side.
Firelight trails behind me.
I stop and shake out my wrist.

lines.zh: 我绕开一片还在烧的地。
lines.en: I skirt a patch still burning.
I walk slowly. I am not chasing.
Standing, fire burning at my feet.
A layer of black coats my armor.
No sound comes from my helm.
I am watching the fire.
The ash is thicker here.
I wait for the fire to grow.
My fist opens and closes.
The ground has baked hard under me.
I lower my head a little.
Ash falls from my armor seams.
Smoke rises in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把手臂抬起来看了看。
lines.en: I raise an arm and look at it.
This heat does not trouble me.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走进来的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone to walk in.
The fire has never stopped.
I hear wood splitting.
The ash at your feet is still warm.
You look at my armor and learn nothing.
This used to be something else.
There is ash on your face.
Step back. The fire will advance.
Do you carry water on you?
I have burned in this armor for years.
Your feet are sliding backward.
I will not step aside first.
Your blade rises unsteadily.
Let it go on burning.
A white mark on my armor.
I slid back a stretch.
I grit my teeth and bear it.
My knee buckled once.

lines.zh: 血落在热灰上，滋了一声。
lines.en: Blood on hot ash hisses.
I step back into position.
I will remember that blow.
A scratch like that only stokes my fire.
Can that thing burn?
Leave it there.
That flame is not strong enough.
That bit of wood in your hand.
Throw it. I will catch it.
I do not eat it. I burn it.
This flame will die quickly.
You carry something combustible.
Come a little nearer.
One step back and I take it.
You hit the armor and bounced.

lines.zh: 火苗往你那边跳了一下。
lines.en: A flame leaps toward you.
Let me through, please.
Your clothes would catch.
That force will not move me.
Steady. Leave my shoulder alone.
You stepped in hot ash.
One step back suits us both.
I never flinch.
This body is burning.
There is none of that in the fire.
I do not remember before.
Do not come near. It burns.
This fire is all I know.
That topic does not suit me.
I do not even have a face.
Get out of my way now.
Let me burn in peace.
That is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根烧焦的木头。
lines.en: I pick up a charred branch.
It catches in my hand.
This will burn to ash.
The ground is thick with ash.
I hold it up to look.
I throw it back into the fire.

lines.zh: 那点掉落物，也值得你弯腰？
lines.en: Is that scrap worth bending over for?
The flames will collect everything for me.
You will not escape this time.
Fire rises behind me.
I will leap at you.
The ground you stand on is hot.

lines.zh: 你的位置很好，我够得到。
lines.en: Good position. I can reach it.
It is settled.
I shift my weight forward.
I count where you step.
You cannot back out now.
It has begun.
Fire curls around my hand.
Step up close to me.

lines.zh: 我落地的地方，砖都碎了。
lines.en: The bricks crack where I land.
I am already bearing down.
I grind forward, bit by bit.
Fire crawls along the ground.
Your armor is catching the light.
My fire has burned a long time.
Ash rises under my feet.
I pushed the fire a little forward.
His breathing is fast and rough.
This leap is exactly the right distance.
I need no detour.
You watch the fire, not me.
The fire line narrows your path.
One more beat.
I bend my knees.

lines.zh: 我看你脚下的灰烧红了。
lines.en: I see the ash under you glow red.
You have started coughing.
This is just right.
I vault right at you.
Then let us open.
This blow, right now.
I leap and slam down onto the ground.
A fist comes down trailing fire.
My armor breaks your guard.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己都震了。
lines.en: That one shook even me.
You are shoved back three paces.
Flame catches your sleeve.
My fist cracks the tiles.
I take hold of your armor's edge.
You retreat; I take one step.
Not fast, but very heavy.
Kicked-up ash blinds you.
That will leave you gasping.

lines.zh: 我第二拳从侧上方砸下。
lines.en: My second fist drops from above.

lines.zh: 火先烧起来，然后我才出现。
lines.en: Fire first, then me.
The ash pile collapses; I stand.
The tiles crack under me.
This place used to be quiet.
Embers still on my armor.
I raise my head. All around is burning.
This is no ordinary place.

lines.zh: 焦土上，我的肩先露出来。
lines.en: First my shoulder rises from the ash.
Heat rolls the ash up.
I see a figure.
The fire does not burn me.
I take one step forward.
The air itself is hot.
You are the only one standing.

lines.zh: 火星顺着我的指节往下落。
lines.en: Sparks drip off my knuckles.
Now let it all burn.
Do not think of running.

lines.zh: 三百五十点血，我烧起来了。
lines.en: Three hundred fifty points, and I am burning.
Fire does not hurt me. It feeds me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，护甲响了一声。
lines.en: I land from height and my armor rings.
The blast throws the ash up.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在肩甲上，没进去。
lines.en: An arrow hits my pauldron and does not pierce.
This light is stranger than fire.
Fire cannot cook up food.
Current slides off my armor.
The ash is gone. The fire too.
